name: Pipedrive
summary: Sales-first CRM built around a visual pipeline: track deals, automate follow-ups and forecast revenue — designed for small and mid-size sales teams. A native MCP server (launched mid-2026) connects it to AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude for natural-language CRM actions.
best_for: sales teams that want a simple, visual pipeline they can use on day one, with a separate marketing tool already in place
skip_if: you want marketing automation in the same tool (HubSpot) or need built-in outbound prospecting
honest_knock: Pipedrive manages what happens after a lead enters your pipeline — it doesn't do outbound prospecting or marketing, so you'll pair it with a separate tool for that. As you scale and need sales, marketing and support data joined up, its sales-only focus starts to lean on add-ons. In our test on 21 October 2026 the trial ran on Premium, the €79-a-seat monthly plan, so list the features you used before you settle on a cheaper seat.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-17 in a browser on pipedrive.com/en/pricing from the Netherlands, both billing views, with Pipedrive's help article on plan features; our 26 August 2026 reading over a US connection showed the same numerals in dollars) Four seat-based plans, VAT exclusive. Billed annually they are €14, €39, €59 and €79 per seat per month for Lite, Growth, Premium and Ultimate, which is one payment of €168, €468, €708 or €948 per seat per year, since Pipedrive charges the year up front. Billed monthly the same plans are €24, €49, €79 and €99 per seat. The page advertises that annual billing saves up to 42%. The numbers do not convert between currencies, they are reprinted with a different symbol, so a European pays materially more for the same seat. The public trial is 14 days with no credit card; the affiliate landing page our own link leads to advertised 30 days when we followed it on 3 September 2026. Five add-ons are priced 'starting from' on the pricing page: LeadBooster €32.50, Projects €16.66, Campaigns €13.33, Web Visitors €41 and Smart Docs €32.50. Pipedrive's help pages say LeadBooster, Projects and Smart Docs are included on Premium and Ultimate and can be bought on Lite and Growth, while Campaigns and Web Visitors are always extra. The terms make all fees non-refundable, and a cancelled account stays usable until the end of the billing cycle.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 21 October 2026 during the 14-day trial, which ran on the Premium plan: Daan created the account with a work email address and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We created three deals, moved one to the next stage, won one and lost one, scheduled a task, ticked it off and looked at the export options.
findings: Sign-up accepted our work email address and opened with a ready-made pipeline 'tailored for your industry' (Qualified, Demo Scheduled, Demo Completed, Proposal Made, Negotiations, Contract Signed), amounts in euros and a 'Try with sample data' button. A 'Call me soon' button for a sales call stayed on screen.

Billing showed 'YOUR PLAN Premium' at €79 per seat billed monthly after the '14-day free trial' (€0 during the trial), with LeadBooster, Smart Docs and Projects included and Campaigns, Automations, Reports and a 'Leads and Deals top-up' sold separately. No card was needed to start.
The new-deal form showed a counter of 0/15,000 that went up with every deal we added: the deals in the account against a limit of 15,000.
Marking a deal Won opened a congratulations screen with suggestions for a follow-up; marking one Lost required a 'Lost reason' before it would close.

A task for the next day appeared under Focus as 'Tomorrow'. Ticking it off showed 'Activity marked as done' and opened 'Schedule your next activity' straight away, already linked to the same deal and organisation.

Tools and apps > Export data offers leads, deals, organisations, people, products, activities, projects, notes and files, as Excel or CSV. The same menu lists 'Pipedrive AI', and the account menu a 'Pipedrive MCP'.
not_tested: The export itself (we did not download a file), and filters on won and lost deals
What stays available on a cheaper plan after the Premium trial
LeadBooster, Campaigns, email sync, automations and Pipedrive AI

vendor_mcp.what: Native server built and maintained by Pipedrive: search deals, contacts, organisations and leads, create and update records, convert leads to deals and schedule follow-ups. Actions follow your existing permissions and land in Pipedrive's change log.
vendor_mcp.plan: "All Pipedrive customers, on every plan." Usage is capped by token limits that depend on your plan, and you can buy extra tokens. Pipedrive has no free plan.
vendor_mcp.note: The vendor's own MCP server, from our MCP research; it works with your own account at the vendor.
